user.title: Set up travel time
user.description: Calculates travel time and distance from a person to a zone using an OSRM routing service. Default is the FOSSGIS e.V. service (OpenStreetMap); every query sends the location and destination to that server.

error.ungueltige_adresse: The address must start with http:// or https://.
error.nicht_erreichbar: The routing service is unreachable or returned no route.

abort.already_configured: This person/destination pair is already configured.

init.title: Queries and fallback
init.description: The brake protects the routing service: new queries only after movement or when the value is stale, a pause after errors, and a daily limit. While no query is allowed, travel time is estimated from the straight-line distance.

data.nur_unterwegs: Only query while the person is away from the destination
data.min_bewegung: New query after moving at least
data.max_alter: Query again at the latest after
